title: Alpha One — event payout.approved v1
description: V1 catalog event `payout.approved` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = LED-07 (payout obligation posting), NOT-01 (template: payout_approved — D61, event-consumed via the docs/14 §3.3 mapping), ANA-01. Derived from: docs/11 §4.1 (payout.approved) + docs/32 `payout_requests` (id, account_id, approved amount, approved_by/at per the approval path §3.5). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.
